title: Usage

location.series: IBM Logo and Brand Guidelines for Third Parties / copyright 2022

slide_intent: Balance relationship explanation with visual prominence, because equal partners can appear unequal when their logos occupy different visual weights.
strategic_value: Secondary placement and equal visual weight can help IBM appear accurately within a third party’s communication.
demonstration: An introductory column sits beside three columns of rules about descriptive text, placement, multiple partners, clear space and web links.
practical_value: Give IBM a secondary position within the host communication while matching the visual weight of equivalent partner marks.

content_islands.name: Usage introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and short instruction in the leftmost column.

content_islands.name: Role and position
content_islands.spec: Use the next column to describe explanatory text and secondary placement outside fixed navigation or mastheads.

content_islands.name: Equivalent partners
content_islands.spec: Continue with collective-role text and equal visual weight across equivalent trademarks.

content_islands.name: Isolation and links
content_islands.spec: End with clear-space and IBM destination-link instructions.

ingredient.name: Third-party IBM mark prominence
ingredient.role: Clarify contribution without implying authorship or unequal partner status.
ingredient.application: Place the mark near descriptive role text in the body of the communication; give equivalent partner marks equal visual weight rather than mechanically equal dimensions.
ingredient.scope: Copyright 2022 third-party guide. Secondary placement refers to the host communication; equal visual weight refers to equivalent third-party marks shown together.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains that size, color and shape alter prominence, so equal visual weight differs from equal size.
reference_purposes.Application: The rules describe how to combine IBM with explanatory text and other partner marks.
reference_purposes.Constraint: IBM remains secondary to the host communication, must not occupy fixed masthead/navigation positions, and must link to ibm.com when used as a linking device.
